camel_example: aliyun dbs DescribeBackupSetDownloadTaskList --region cn-hangzhou --BackupSetDownloadTaskId urxgrxt70000 --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --BackupPlanId dbsqhnuhyw30000 --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzXXXXXX
description_en: Queries the list of download tasks for backup sets in Database Backup Service (DBS)
description_zh: 该接口用于查看DBS备份集下载列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbs describe-backup-set-download-task-list --backup-plan-id dbsqhnuhyw30000 --backup-set-download-task-id urxgrxt70000 --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzXXXXXX --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupSetDownloadTaskList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

You must specify either BackupPlanId or BackupSetDownloadTaskId
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

BackupPlanId或BackupSetDownloadTaskId任选其一作为请求参数必填项
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set download task.

For a full backup, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869842.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

For an incremental backup, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869843.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备份集下载任务ID。

全量备份：可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869842.html接口获取该参数的值。
增量备份：可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869843.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_set_download_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数，取值30、50、100。

默认每页记录数为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a non-negative integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the integer type. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于等于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为0
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate requests
parameters.help_zh: 输入任意值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The details of the returned parameters

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

BackupSetDownloadTaskDetail.description_en: The details of the backup set download task

items.description_en: The details of the backup set download task

BackupGatewayId.description_en: The backup gateway for the backup set. This parameter has a value only for automatic downloads
BackupGatewayId.description_zh: 备份集备份网关，仅自动下载有值

BackupPlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup plan

BackupSetCode.description_en: The encoding of the source backup set

BackupSetDataFormat.description_en:
The data format of the downloaded backup set. Valid values:

Native

SQL

CSV

JSON
BackupSetDataFormat.description_zh:
备份集下载数据格式，取值如下：

Native
SQL
CSV 
JSON

BackupSetDataSize.description_en: The size of the backup set data

BackupSetDownloadCreateTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the task was created

BackupSetDownloadDir.description_en:
The directory on the server to which the backup set is downloaded.

This parameter has a value only for automatic downloads
BackupSetDownloadDir.description_zh:
备份集下载服务器目录。

仅自动下载有值

BackupSetDownloadFinishTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the task was completed

BackupSetDownloadInternetUrl.description_en:
The public network download URL for the backup set.

This parameter has a value only for manual downloads when the format conversion is complete
BackupSetDownloadInternetUrl.description_zh:
备份集公网下载地址。

仅手工下载类型，且转换完成的有值

BackupSetDownloadIntranetUrl.description_en:
The internal download URL for the backup set.

This parameter has a value only for manual downloads when the format conversion is complete
BackupSetDownloadIntranetUrl.description_zh:
备份集内网下载地址。

仅手工下载类型，且转换完成的有值

BackupSetDownloadStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set download. Valid values:

checking: The task is being prechecked.

init: The precheck failed and the task is not started.

check_pass: The precheck is passed.

pause: The task is paused.

schedule: The task is waiting to be scheduled.

running: The task is running.

stop: The task failed.

finish: The task is complete
BackupSetDownloadStatus.description_zh:
备份集下载状态，返回值如下：

checking：预检查中
init：预检查失败（未启动）
check_pass：预检查通过
pause：暂停
schedule：等待调度
running：运行中
stop：失败
finish：完成

BackupSetDownloadTargetType.description_en:
The target type for the backup set download.

This parameter is displayed only for automatic downloads. The value \`agent\` indicates that a backup gateway is installed
BackupSetDownloadTargetType.description_zh:
备份集下载目标类型。

仅自动下载显示，agent表示已安装备份网关

BackupSetDownloadTaskId.description_en: The ID of the backup set download task

BackupSetDownloadTaskName.description_en: The name of the backup set download task

BackupSetDownloadWay.description_en:
The download type. Valid values:

manual: Manual

auto: Automatic
BackupSetDownloadWay.description_zh:
下载类型，返回值如下：

manual：手工
auto：自动

BackupSetId.description_en: The ID of the source backup set

BackupSetJobType.description_en:
The type of the source backup set task. Valid values:

cbs_backup_sub_full: Logical full backup task

cbs_backup_sub_cont: Logical incremental backup task
BackupSetJobType.description_zh:
源备份集任务类型，返回值如下：

cbs_backup_sub_full：逻辑全量任务
cbs_backup_sub_cont：逻辑增量任务

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

TotalElements.description_en: The total number of download records for backup sets
